# Blue Ox Tree Care

> ISA Board Certified Master Arborist owned tree care serving Austin, Round Rock, Bee Cave, and Lakeway, Texas.

Blue Ox Tree Care LLC is a family-owned, licensed, and insured tree service. Co-owners Travis Berlin (ISA BCMA, RM-7612B) and Lacy Berlin (ISA Certified Arborist, RM-8632A) provide professional arboriculture across the Austin metro. This is a service-area business with no public storefront — arborists come to your property.

## Credentials & Trust

- ISA Board Certified Master Arborist (BCMA) owned & operated
- Fewer than 2% of ISA Certified Arborists earn the BCMA credential
- Licensed and insured for hazardous tree work
- Free estimates for most projects
- Organic, in-house pest and disease treatments (specialty)

## History Note

Travis Berlin previously managed trees at Disneyland (Anaheim, CA) and served as a municipal arborist in Newport Beach, CA. Blue Ox Tree Care operated in Salida, Colorado before relocating to Central Texas. Salida is part of the company's history; the current service area is Austin and Central Texas only.
